headline: Australia Commits A$180 Million to Victoria Rare Earths Mine
summary: The Australian federal government has invested A$180 million in a planned rare earths and mineral sands mining project in western Victoria despite local pushback.
why: Western governments are funding domestic critical minerals to reduce dependence on China for components essential to electronics, defense, and renewables.

impacts.name: Rare Earths Mining
impacts.why: State capital injection speeds mine development and secures domestic critical mineral processing.
